system.description:
Strange Check with CR equal to a dead target's CR. Matching the CR revives it briefly (3 Combat Rounds in combat): it can move and attack but has little or no mind. Exceeding the CR makes it closer to its living self, depending on the margin. Doom +3.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.68

automation.label: CR = the dead target's CR
automation.onSuccess: The target rises (3 Combat Rounds in combat), mobile and able to attack; the Director decides how much each success above its CR restores of its living self.
